baslik: An Empty Fuel Tank Destroyed TWA Flight 800

sahneler.metin: Minutes after take-off, a jumbo jet exploded off Long Island.
It broke apart and fell into the ocean, killing everyone aboard.
Investigators traced the blast to the centre fuel tank.
Heat from the air-conditioning units warmed the vapour inside.
Warm fuel vapour is far easier to ignite than liquid fuel.
A spark, most likely from wiring, set it off.
New rules now require airliners to make those tanks far less flammable.
